name: MCU Timeline
description: Brings the Marvel Cinematic Universe into Jellyfin, in release or story order, matched with your library. Pick any of: a timeline page with Marvel filters, watch tracking and Jellyseerr requests, a playlist for each order, an MCU collection.
overview: The Marvel Cinematic Universe in Jellyfin: timeline page, playlists, collection.

versions.changelog:
The timeline can be dragged with the mouse, and the bar under it no longer gets stuck.
Posters of missing titles load through Jellyfin, for networks that block TMDB.
New plugin image.
New MCU collection with every title of the library, and its own poster and backdrop.
The timeline page, each playlist and the collection have their own switch in the settings, all off on a new install. Playlists made by an earlier version stay on. Turning one off removes it from Jellyfin.
Works on Jellyfin 10.9, 10.10, 10.11 and 12.
